\paragraph{Frozen theorem statement.}
For every finite derivative order $M$, cover the full class-angle interval
$[0,\pi]$ by identity, transition, and cut charts.  On the first two charts,
bound the paired image correction, prove a positive lower bound before
logarithmic differentiation, and add the Euler-product sine correction.  On
the cut chart, pair radial images about odd multiples of $\pi$, bound the
kernel below by its principal pair, and transfer derivative bounds through
$-\log p_t$.  At the antipode, recover the $t^{-5/2}$ Morse--Bott prefactor
from the $S^2$-family of minimizing geodesics.  The normalized Haar tail and
the local lattice Hessian corollary retain the stated heat-kernel
normalization.  The rational validation specializes to
$M=8$, $t_0=1/5$, $\rho=1$, and $\delta=1/5$.
